slides.headline: Why is Apple locking down your Mac files?
Apple announced stricter file permissions
slides.body: New macOS rules limit which apps can see all your files, citing AI agent risks.

slides.headline: AI agents can now read everything
slides.body: Autonomous AI tools that act on your behalf can access photos, documents, and passwords if granted Full Disk Access.

slides.headline: Your private data is the target
slides.body: Tax returns, medical records, and family photos could be scanned by AI without you realizing which app asked.

slides.headline: Legitimate apps may stop working
slides.body: Backup tools, password managers, and disk cleaners will need re-approval — some may break until updated.

slides.headline: Stay ahead of AI privacy risks
slides.body: Follow for plain-English AI security news that protects your data.
